collection.description: A well-liked teenager repeatedly humiliates a quieter peer, and bystanders are afraid of losing their own standing.

setup.name: The setup
setup.text: (bully), a well-liked teenager, repeatedly humiliates (target), a quieter peer, and bystanders are afraid of losing their own standing.

a1.name: Outcome A1
a1.text: They describe a pattern no adult had noticed.

a2.name: Outcome A2
a2.text: They ask for protection without a public confrontation.

b1.name: Outcome B1
b1.text: (bully) accepts a proportionate consequence and begins changing.

b2.name: Outcome B2
b2.text: They argue that everyone laughed; (elder) explains laughter is not consent.

c1.name: Outcome C1
c1.text: (friend) interrupts the next insult without escalating.

c2.name: Outcome C2
c2.text: Some admit their silence helped the pattern continue.

d2.name: Outcome D2
d2.text: The community measures improvement by conduct, not a single apology.
